scope: Source and protocol review, not independent human relabelling

corrections.incorrect_claim: Returning None from default is the encoder protocol's own not-serializable signal.
corrections.correction: JSONEncoder.default must return a JSON-serializable value or raise TypeError. Returning None serializes as JSON null; it is not a not-serializable signal and does not skip the item. The source comment may express an intentional lossy-cache policy, but caller correctness has not been independently adjudicated. The historical CONTRACT label is retained as a record, not reaffirmed.
